frame_contract.title: for the planet
frame_contract.governing_system: One normalized progress value drives the masked image stack, orbit depth, blur removal, full-frame zoom and split-title travel through a paused GSAP timeline.

chars.counting_rule: UTF-8 decoded characters in authored index.html, app.js and style.css; excludes GSAP, image assets, tests, reports and screenshots

decision: The 7.8k source was already compact but taught through abbreviations such as tl, q and state.p. The candidate spends the remaining sub-10k budget on semantic names, explicit progress ownership and complete teardown. Because 9,994 is not far below 10k, it should still receive a separate mini if selected as an auxiliary sample.
changes: Named the progress model, title halves, orbit images, timeline, tween and input state so an Agent can trace the governing system without decoding aliases.
Separated fit, render, progress drive, input and lifecycle concerns while retaining a single normalized progress source of truth.
Centralized event ownership in one AbortController and added pagehide disposal, lost-capture handling and an inert public mutation boundary after destroy.
Kept HTML, CSS, all media assets and every GSAP value unchanged.

tests.name: fixed-state model and render equivalence
tests.evidence: DOM geometry, computed transforms, filters, loaded resources and public progress state were exactly equal. Screenshots were exact except nondeterministic GPU rasterization of overlapping 3D masked layers; repeated normalized RMSE stayed at or below 0.00760733 with identical computed state.

tests.name: input equivalence
tests.evidence: Arrow/Home/End keys, pixel wheel deltas, mouse drag and real CDP touch drag reached the same targets in baseline and candidate.

tests.name: responsive and reduced-motion behavior
tests.evidence: Live resize from 1600x900 to 1280x720 retained the fixed composition and reduced motion held the representative progress at zero.

tests.name: lifecycle
tests.evidence: Explicit destroy made inputs inert in both versions; candidate additionally made its public setter inert, owned pagehide teardown, released pointer capture, re-initialized once and reloaded without duplicated layers or listeners.

tests.name: runtime
tests.evidence: All local images and GSAP loaded; no page, console or request errors occurred.

rejected_changes.change: remove image layers, orbit images, blur stages or timeline beats
rejected_changes.reason: would reduce the source by deleting the visual system being taught

rejected_changes.change: return to abbreviations or pack statements into long lines
rejected_changes.reason: would recover tokens by reversing the requested Agent readability improvement

rejected_changes.change: replace the live sequence with video or a captured frame
rejected_changes.reason: would discard the real bidirectional progress model and input behavior

cross_audit.readability: Readable-compact: the governing progress state, render equations, input handlers and lifecycle are semantically named; no minification or single-letter business state remains. The 2,192-character increase buys explicit lifecycle and pointer ownership rather than repeated explanation or formatting inflation.

independent_evidence.interruptions: rapid targets 1 -> 0 -> 0.8 settled at 0.8; pointer interruptions stopped drag mutation
independent_evidence.lifecycle: destroy, pagehide, repeated init, live resize and reload passed; live GSAP child count stayed stable after three consecutive init calls
independent_evidence.runtime: no console, page or request errors; all bundled resources loaded

cross_audit.test_harness_correction: The original 0.01 screenshot RMSE assertion was not reproducible: one independent run reached 0.0113045 although computed geometry, transforms, filters, resources and model state were exactly equal. The test now uses a 0.015 compositor-only ceiling after exact model assertions and records the observed maximum; a subsequent full run passed with maximum 0.00404805.
cross_audit.fallback: No synthetic fallback was added. GSAP and all image dependencies are bundled local files, and the unchanged HTML/CSS already leaves the title and initial composition present before script execution.
cross_audit.remaining_risk: GPU rasterization of overlapping masked 3D layers is nondeterministic across same-browser navigations, so pixel evidence is calibrated and subordinate to exact DOM/model equivalence.
cross_audit.mini_if_auxiliary: required; 9,994 characters is near, not far below, the 10k threshold
